tools.name: url_safety_check
tools.description: Phishing check / url safety / scam detection: is this link safe to open, click or pay? Checks MetaMask + Phishing.Database blocklists on every redirect hop, domain age (RDAP), DNS, HTTPS, punycode and brand lookalikes, password forms and scam wording. Returns risk low/medium/high, safe_to_open and reasons. Costs $0.005 USDC on Base via x402; only charged on success.

tools.name: safe_read
tools.description: Safe browse for agents / prompt injection scan: read a web page (url) or raw html as clean Markdown with hidden text, HTML comments, invisible Unicode and prompt injections removed, plus verdict clean/suspicious/malicious and what was removed. Use before putting untrusted web content into an agent's context. Costs $0.005 USDC on Base via x402; only charged on success.
